title: Work/Life Balance
description: Attraverso il Servizio pari opportunità, l’USI promuove diversi programmi e misure a sostegno della conciliazione tra vita professionale e vita privata dei collaboratori e delle collaboratrici, degli studenti e delle studentesse.

blocks.html:
Through the Equal Opportunities Service, USI promotes various programmes and measures to support the work-life balance of male and female employees and students.

Reconciliation measures act on complementary dimensions, taking into account not only the needs dictated by family responsibilities, but also other dimensions of diversity and inclusion linked to the state of health of employees and students and their psycho-physical wellbeing.

Specifically, the reconciliation measures offered by USI include:

  • practical information and advice on parental rights;
  • services, activities and practical information on childcare and support for family carers;
  • access to flexible working and training arrangements;
  • services and practical information for people with disabilities (permanent or temporary) or chronic illnesses;
  • services and practical information for people in dual career couples.

The Equal Opportunities Service team is available to provide information and personalised advice on work-life balance.
